item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:35 HKT 18/Apr/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a southerly airstream, there will be a few showers over the coastal areas of Guangdong and hot during the day in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, a trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to southern China. With a trough of low pressure edging closer to the coastal areas gradually, showers will be heavy at times with squally thunderstorms over the region early next week. The trough of low pressure will persistently affect the coast of southern China midweek next week.
